prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. This is a CREATIVE GLAMOUR CHARACTER REDESIGN for ARC Daily's esports stars, not a literal identity-preserving photo edit. The editor has explicitly rejected raw photographic faces pasted onto armor. Make a NEW, IDEALIZED, HEROIC, CLEARLY ILLUSTRATED character loosely inspired by the source. The face MUST be entirely redrawn: polished airbrushed/painted skin, clean sculpted cheekbones, stronger attractive jawline, balanced features, groomed hair, expressive striking eyes, healthy flattering complexion. Remove blemishes, visible pores, under-eye tiredness and incidental snapshot imperfections. Retain only distinctive broad identity cues such as hair color, beard and eyewear so the inspiration is readable. Do NOT retain the exact source photograph's facial geometry, lighting, texture, head pose or awkward snapshot expression. Do NOT paste or reproduce a photographic face. This is the handsome heightened storybook/superhero version of the person, like the established Jack Cole character, not their literal head.
Image1 is the established Jack Cole illustrated character: use its COHERENT PAINTED/INKED HUMAN FACE AND MECHANICALLY INTEGRATED HEADGEAR style only, ignore its face identity, text and history. Image2 is this subject's photograph: use ONLY broad recognizable visual inspiration, deliberately glamour-redesign it as above. Image3 supplies established story/costume/composition context only, not extra characters or another face. Rich premium cinematic CYBERPUNK illustrated realism, stylized graphic-novel facial anatomy and controlled hand-inked planes across face/neck/hands and machines, no photography, no anime, no retro pulp paper or halftone. Face and costume are painted as one original artwork. A bold distinctive narrative role is central, not another generic engineer holding a little cube. Enormous graphics-card equipment, exposed heat sinks, cooling fans, cable conduits and geometric colored square ARC displays remain our world language. All wardrobe and machinery are fantasy editorial character design, not claims about actual competition methods.
Full bleed portrait5:7, ideally1500x2100. Strong composition, head and essential hands/gear fully contained, upper two thirds carry identity and narrative, calmer dark lower edge for later stats. No words, digits, logos, title, caption, watermark, frame, rank or card border. One principal hero. MYKYTA: THE LAST DANCE'S RHYTHM INVENTOR. Image3's THIRD dancer is his established cyan/green ARC-grid costume and expressive movement reference; do not use the other three teammates. Broad facial inspiration only: tousled fair/copper hair, full ginger beard, light eyes. Transform this into a strikingly handsome charismatic heroic INVENTOR-SHOWMAN: groomed swept copper quiff, luxurious neatly sculpted ginger beard, strong angular cheekbones, brighter piercing blue-green eyes, attractive confident slightly mischievous grin, perfectly painted flattering skin. A mature adult with real human proportions, no photo texture. Deliberately more glamorous and heroic than the snapshot; don't merely copy the original face.
Dynamic three-quarter upper-body action portrait: he is mid-turn above a glowing ARC-grid dance floor, conducting two large mechanical ARMORED COMPUTE GAUNTLETS whose articulated colored square modules unfold into a swirling precise lattice of puzzle tiles. One glove reaches toward the viewer in tasteful foreshortening; other guides a curving loop of glowing geometric grid panels. Strong shoulders and lively torso gesture make his rhythm apparent without tiny full-body framing. A spectacular OFF-CENTER GYROSCOPIC GPU ENGINE hangs behind one hip/shoulder on a real diagonal harness, an enormous copper heat-sink flywheel around a recognizable multi-fan graphics-card assembly, visible green PCB edges, huge teal cooling tubes and mechanical timing wheels. The machinery feels like an inventor's eccentric wearable kinetic instrument, not the mastermind's throne or the same generic backpack.
Preserve cyan/emerald ARC-grid streetwear but elevate it into premium dark-teal leather and brushed brass cybernetic performance gear. Unique slim double-rail brow rig, one small rotating clockwork optical loupe above an eyebrow, ear-mounted circuit modules, articulated copper cheek/jaw supports that frame rather than hide the handsome ginger beard, flexible cables feed gauntlets. Hair, eyes and grin dominate instead of hardware hiding the entire face. Backdrop: cathedral scoring hall transformed into a dramatic grid dance arena with luminous square reflections, emerald/cyan and hot amber rim light, a few distant silhouettes only. Powerful, ingenious, playful and unmistakably glamorous, a superstar with his own story.
